SaveDirectory

The directory where save game data is stored. Uses Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData by default. Savegame location will be SaveDirectory \ ApplicationName.

public readonly Environment.SpecialFolder? SaveDirectory

Field Value

Environment.SpecialFolder?

Remarks

Good alternatives for save game locations include:

  • Environment.SpecialFolder.ApplicationData \- for roaming user data.
  • Environment.SpecialFolder.MyDocuments \- for user-accessible files.
  • Environment.SpecialFolder.CommonApplicationData \- for data shared among all users.

Choose based on your application's requirements and platform conventions.
